page: Amazon Web Services g7e.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8559C processor with 8 vCPUs, 4 physical cores, and 2 threads per core running at 2.4 GHz, supported by a 320 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA Blackwell RTX Pro 6000 GPU with 96 GB of VRAM.

The instance features 1900 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps. The Intel Xeon CPU supports advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), which accelerate deep learning and matrix multiplication workloads. Cryptographic acceleration is also supported via AES and SHA_NI flags.

In benchmark testing, the g7e.2xlarge demonstrates top-tier performance in Geekbench single-core and text processing tests, as well as in LLM inference speeds for prompt processing and text generation using small and medium models. It also achieves strong performance in single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression. This hardware profile is optimized for graphics-intensive applications, large language model inference, and data-intensive workloads requiring high-speed local NVMe storage and high network throughput.
